public_api_notes.RoutingRecommendation: Advisory recommendation; carries execution_status=NOT_EXECUTED and recommendation_only=true.
public_api_notes.FallbackRecommendation: Ordered fallback candidates + conditions and escalation conditions. The controller never executes fallback or escalation.
public_api_notes.SteeringResult: When nothing is eligible, status=NO_ELIGIBLE_CANDIDATE, recommendation=None, and evidence still explains every rejection (typed outcome, not an arbitrary fallback).

provider_execution_location: model_selection_pilot/ (monorepo-only research pilot; provider.py + execute.py; credential-blocked; NOT packaged; may become a separate, independently-governed runtime adapter in a future phase)
selection_leaf_distribution: ugence-model-selection (separate distribution; deterministic eligibility + policy scoring over an already-approved candidate set; NOT a dependency of this package)
research_routing_engines: model_selection_experiment/policy.py (RESEARCH_ONLY, dict-based route + fusion; self-declared separate)
known_limitations: Advisory-only: produces routing recommendations; contains no code capable of executing them.
All scores are ESTIMATED from declared/configured metadata; no measured production quality, cost, latency, or reliability is claimed or validated.
No best-model, cost-savings, latency-reduction, reliability, or provider-availability claim is made.
Provider execution, retries, and fallback execution are NOT included; they belong to a separately governed runtime.
provenance_policy: The static manifest carries stable metadata only. The actual build revision is generated at build/verification time from GITHUB_SHA or `git rev-parse HEAD` into artifacts/build_provenance.json (evidence_class CI_GENERATED_BUILD_EVIDENCE). No self-referential commit SHA is stored here.
